entries.scope: mods/Biology/info.json and official REDmod package root
entries.reason: Biology's official first-party package identity lives under the game's REDmod mods directory.

entries.scope: tools/Build-BiologyPackage.ps1 game-root-shaped playable candidate and biology ownership/provenance metadata
entries.reason: The integrated release is REDmod-first: mods/Biology is the first-party identity and REDmod deployment is the official package/load authority, with individually justified supplemental runtime files where REDmod whole-file replacement would be less robust.
REDmod natively stages archives from a mod package. No first-party archive payload is required by the current merged candidate.
REDmod natively compiles tweak source. No first-party tweak source is required by the current merged candidate.
REDmod has a native customSounds route; current Biology source contains no custom audio payload.
Cooked first-party resource payload belongs under Biology's REDmod identity when such assets actually exist; runtime controller behavior remains separately classified.

entries.scope: complete merged src/redscript/CyberpunkRealism/*.reds project-owned models/runtime classes without whole-file vanilla replacement
entries.reason: The integrated runtime is additive project-owned REDscript and shares narrow wrapper seams. Forcing it into REDmod's vanilla-path .script replacement model would broaden replacement ownership rather than reduce compatibility surface.

entries.scope: hook files enumerated in manifest/native-seams.json using @wrapMethod/@replaceMethod/@addMethod/@addField
entries.reason: These seams intentionally intercept small game-facing methods. Whole-file REDmod script replacement would copy/own substantially more vanilla implementation for the same behavior. Exact compilation against 2.31 is a mandatory integrated build gate.

entries.scope: copying vanilla .script files from tools/redmod/scripts solely to replace current wrapper/additive hooks
entries.reason: Official REDmod supports modified vanilla-path scripts, but conflict is at file granularity and a game patch can invalidate copied implementation unrelated to Biology's narrow hook.

entries.scope: merged project-owned Ink/REDscript controller/runtime behavior for Biology body shell, HUD and nameplates
entries.reason: PR #32 and PR #33 implement these surfaces as Biology-owned additive/wrapper REDscript without requesting a new framework or REDmod asset dependency. Whole vanilla-file replacement would broaden their seam.

entries.scope: RealpassSettings.reds ModSettings runtimeProperty/listener adapter for Enable Biology and E3-inspired HUD + nameplates
entries.reason: The setting semantics are now Biology-owned/provider-neutral, but PR #33 did not implement another accessible persistent provider. Mod Settings is therefore retained only for this playable candidate so the parent can test master-disable and E3 ON/OFF. Replacement implementation belongs to the presentation/settings lane.

entries.reason: Packaging can remove Mod Settings/ArchiveXL/RED4ext only after Lane C supplies and accepts a replacement provider or deliberately moves the whole-mod boundary to install/deploy. This lane must not invent a new settings UI.

entries.scope: manifest/package.json, tools/Build-Package.ps1 and tools/Build-CleanRoomTestPackage.ps1 as the active final architecture
entries.reason: Build-BiologyPackage.ps1 supersedes them as the intended integrated candidate route, but PKG-06 forbids deleting/retiring the known working fallback until the REDmod-first package exact-compiles, deploys, and reaches equivalent or better reproducibility in direct testing.

entries.scope: archive/pc/mod as a default Biology first-party deployment route
entries.reason: No project-original archive source currently requires the legacy root. New first-party archive content should use mods/Biology/archives.

Direct read-only probe confirmed tools/redmod/bin/redMod.exe, file version 2.3.1.0 / product version 2.31, deploy module and global -root parameter. Deterministic tooling always passes -root explicitly.

entries.scope: actual recognition/deployment of the integrated mods/Biology candidate
entries.reason: The package is now structurally playable, but recognition/deploy success must be observed against the supported install after merge; CI cannot prove it.

entries.scope: actual precedence when two enabled REDmods overlap the same safe fixture file
entries.reason: Official documentation describes order semantics, but PKG-05 requires harmless direct local evidence before Biology depends on that precedence.

entries.scope: future Biology-owned or generic DLL/native hook
entries.reason: Reserved for a concrete feature that cannot be implemented safely through vanilla semantics, REDmod, or retained redscript. No current merged Biology feature proves such a requirement.
